senses.gloss: (sub. זרע) to sprout, germinate, produce withered growth.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7">Num. R. s. 7</cite> (ref. to <he>תפריחי</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 17:11">Is. XVII, 11</cite>) <he>בבקר … ומצא אותה שהִפְרִיגָה</he> in the morning he went to look at it (the garden planted with cabbage) and found that it (its growth) had germinated (and the cabbage was ruined); <he>בערב היית … הרי הִפְרַגְתְּ</he> in the evening thou wast fine and excellent, and in the morning, behold, thou art ruined; (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:3">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>שהוריקה</he>, v. <cite ref="J00653"><he>יָרַק</he></cite>).
